summary: Phase 4b batch (8 features) tested. Backend 14/14 NEW + 11/11 ET1 regression = 25/25 PASS (100%). Frontend testids verified in source and live for ET1 scan-btn, witness tab/invite-open-btn/invite-modal, public witness page (with real token), letter-tone-hint, cost-tab buttons, postcode input, region-badge. One minor frontend issue found: WitnessPublicPage renders the 'Link not recognised' error card WITHOUT the data-testid='witness-public-page' wrapper (only the form-state path has it). Cost/Letter modal couldn't be opened live in 2nd browser run due to a stale Lex Vault PIN overlay opening on dashboard (likely a harness-state issue — source code has all testids and backend APIs return 200 correctly).

ui_bugs.issue: When token is invalid/expired/already-submitted/revoked, the error card is rendered WITHOUT the outer <div data-testid='witness-public-page'>. The 'ready' (form) path has it, but the error/loading paths return a different JSX root. Tests/automation that look for the wrapper testid will see 'not present' for invalid tokens.

action_items: (Optional, LOW) Wrap the error/loading branches of WitnessPublicPage in the same <div data-testid='witness-public-page'> so the testid is always present regardless of state. Improves observability for automation.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is 13,885 lines — well over the 700-line guideline. Should be split into route/modal/component modules. Same finding flagged in previous iterations; still applies after this batch.
server.py is 12,097 lines — also far above the 700-line guideline.

All 8 new endpoints behave correctly under load: counter-ladder (~30s), timeline summarise (~15s), OCR (~10s), cost estimate with postcode (~3s), legal-letter with tone (~10s). Generous timeouts in tests confirm.

Witness flow is correctly idempotent: single-use token enforced (409 on resubmit), public fetch returns 'already_submitted' after submit, statement_of_truth=false returns 400, statement <80 chars returns 422 (Pydantic).

Cost-estimate postcode multiplier (EC1A → 1.55 'Central London (premium)') confirmed. Comparison block returns all 3 sections (diy/ai_advocate/solicitor) with total_low/high + pros/cons. Saving banner numbers present.
Legal letter accepts new `tone` field while remaining backwards-compatible (call without tone still works — regression test green).

success_rate.frontend: 85% (testids verified in source + 5/6 live flows; CostEstimateModal/LegalLetterModal live-open blocked by a stray Vault PIN overlay in 2nd test run, but their testids confirmed present via grep and via first browser exploration)

test_credentials: appstore.reviewer@aiadvocate.co.uk / Review2026!Lex (Pro/reviewer tier, used for all 25 backend tests) — login returns access_token (not 'token'). LocalStorage key is 'aa_token'. sessionStorage 'aa_skip_marketing'='1' needed to bypass marketing landing on / for authed users.
seed_data_creation: Each backend test class creates fresh TEST_* cases via /api/cases. Witness invites + statements created end-to-end. No global seed needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_iter23_phase4b.py covers OCR / counter-ladder / timeline summary / witness invite+submit+list+PDF / legal-letter tone / cost-estimate postcode+compare. All 14 new + 11 ET1 regression pass. For UI re-testing: use /app/app route AFTER setting localStorage.aa_token = <access_token from /api/auth/login>. Dismiss any Lex Vault PIN setup modal (click X) before clicking dashboard tiles, otherwise it intercepts subsequent clicks. Witness public page lives at /witness/<token> (no auth). Cost-modal testids: cost-postcode, cost-tab-summary, cost-tab-compare, cost-region-badge, cost-saving-banner. Letter tone pills use dynamic testid pattern `letter-tone-${tone}` — letter-tone-hint always present.
rca of the issue: WitnessPublicPage component returns early for non-'ready' status (invalid/expired/already_submitted/revoked) with a card that lacks the outer data-testid='witness-public-page'. The form-rendering branch (status==='ready') is the only path that wraps content in that testid. Fix: hoist the wrapper <div data-testid='witness-public-page'> to be the top-level returned element for all status branches in WitnessPublicPage (around the early returns).
